sampling_policy: Each carrier is sampled exactly once, by scripts/build_probe_samples.py (seeded, order-independent, metadata-only); the receipt under docs/receipts/probe-samples/ is frozen and every later experiment on that carrier resolves its items through the binding in this manifest — never through a fresh draw. Adding a carrier means adding a new receipt through the same script and regenerating this manifest; changing an existing receipt requires owner approval and a new probe entry. R4 draws from the already-frozen dev subset10 split receipt (docs/receipts/splits.json); R3 has no sample yet (data acquisition blocked).
